profiles.note: One Kalphite Queen basic attack only. Ranged/magic always pass accuracy, but can roll zero; matching protection blocks HP damage. Melee uses ordinary accuracy. The melee-range 50/25/25 attack mixture, ranged prayer drain, workers, movement and respawn are not simulated.
Supreme's basic ranged attack only. Matching protection blocks it. Poison, Spinolyps, overlapping King aggro, respawn and full-trip supplies are excluded.
Prime's basic magic attack only. Matching protection blocks it. Spinolyps, overlapping King aggro, movement, respawn and full-trip supplies are excluded.
Rex's basic slash attack only. Matching protection blocks it. A successful safespot can avoid attack attempts, but is not assumed here. Spinolyps, overlapping King aggro and respawn are excluded.
Normal three-hit chains only. Blood healing is included; curses, glyph movement, special attacks, self-damage, camp potions and attack-window timing are not simulated.
Normal three-hit chains only. Protection prayers do not block these hits. Curses, clone/parry phases, special attacks, camp potions and movement are not simulated.
Selected basic attack only. Set effects, prayer drain and tunnels are not included.
Dharok's damage changes with missing health. A fixed max hit would understate risk; this incoming model is not implemented yet.
Guthan's basic attack and 25% healing proc only; prayer drain, tunnels and attack downtime are excluded.
Verac can bypass accuracy and protection prayer. Its set-effect damage distribution is not implemented yet.
One Zilyana basic-attack scenario only. Melee-range behaviour, mixed attack frequency, movement and all three bodyguards are excluded.
One Graardor basic-attack scenario only. Ranged hits roll 15–35. Attack mixture, kiting, minions and aggro are excluded.
Sarachnis ranged attacks only. Its melee defence type is unverified; web attacks, healing, melee/ranged transitions and spawns are not included.

Nex Smoke/Ice basic magic only, with correctly timed Protect from Magic leaving 50% damage before per-hit rounding. Other phases, melee, ranged, special attacks, minions and team targeting are unverified.
